SIKAROOF® VERSIWEB® AU: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU, August 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sikaroof-versiwebau.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU is a cellular confinement system used to provide an effective measure for erosion and slope stabilisation by preventing movement of infill material with the individual cells. It is manufactured from recycled high density polyethylene (HDPE) with cell heights ranging from 75 mm to 200 mm for various surface infill depths. SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU comprises strips of perforated, expandable and flexible thermoplastic that are ultra sonically bonded to form a honeycomb matrix. Cells are secured onto slopes at intervaled anchor points according to the specification of geotechnical engineers, or may be stacked in layers to enhance structural and shear strength.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Confinement cells for slope stabilisation of landscape features both on concrete or on-grade surfaces.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM E 41: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Seam strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - High tensile strength
    - Strong and long-term seam weld strength
    - High environmental stress crack resistance
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Operates within a wide service temperature range
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: Black
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Resistance to environmental stress cracking: > 3,000 hours
2.7 Seam strength. Long term seam peel-strength test shall be performed on all resin or pre-manufacturedsheet or strips. A 100mm wide seam sample shall support a 72.5 kg load for a period of 7 days minimum in a temperature controlled environment undergoing a temperature change on a 1 hour cycle from ambient room to 54°C (130°F). Ambient room temperature is per ASTM E 41.
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 75mm high - Dimensions 5.2m x 8.84m = 45.96m²; 100mm high - Dimensions 5.2m x 8.84m = 45.96m²; 150mm high - Dimensions 5.2m x 8.84m = 45.96m²; 200mm high - Dimensions 5.2m x 8.84m = 45.96m²
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet
2.9 Storage conditions. Products must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Notes on installation - Accessories.
    - Tendons - Polymer type and design tensile strength depends on geometry, anchorage design and chemical environment. Long term creep performance is important.
    - Atra Clip - Attached to tendons, provides positive transfer of sliding loads to the tendon system.
    - Tendon Anchor Sysytems - Tendon anchor type depends on geometry, environment, site conditions and infill type. Dead-man crest anchors or earth anchors are generally recommended
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU is not resistant to permanent weathering and UV exposure.
    - When used in combination with Sarnafil® or Sika Plan® membranes, a separation/protection layer is recommended
4.4 . SOIL CONFINEMENT CELLS FOR SLOPE STABILISATION OF LANDSCAPE FEATURES

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiWeb® AU, August 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sikaroof-versiwebau.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
